units.summary: New benchmark helper that opens a DB with compaction disabled, appends N series with in-order samples inside one 1000ms chunk range, commits in batches of 10k, and returns the series refs. It is test-only code and cannot change production behavior.
units.headline: Add benchmark helper building head with N in-order series
units.reason: Test-only helper in a _test.go file; it cannot change production behavior.

units.summary: New test helper that picks count refs spaced evenly across a slice, or copies the whole slice when count >= len. The indexes stay in bounds because i*step < len. Test-only code.
units.headline: Add helper sampling refs at even intervals for benchmarks
units.reason: Pure test utility; it cannot change production behavior.

units.summary: New benchmark that times CompactSelectedSeries on a 100k-series head at several selected fractions. It rebuilds the DB on each iteration and pauses the timer during setup and close. Test-only code.
units.headline: Add benchmark for CompactSelectedSeries across selection fractions
units.reason: New benchmark that only runs in tests; it cannot change production behavior.

units.summary: New public DB method. It sorts and de-duplicates a copy of the caller's refs, filters out series that have out-of-order data, writes blocks tagged FromSelectedSeries for each chunk range via compactHeadViewLocked, then evicts the persisted series from the head using an appendID watermark. It also emits triggered, failed and duration metrics. The previous inline CompactStaleHead logic was moved into the shared compactHeadViewLocked.

issues.title: num_skipped_ooo log counts every filtered-out ref, not just OOO ones
issues.failure_scenario: If the caller passes refs that no longer exist in the head and filterSeriesAndSortPostings drops them, the log reports them as skipped because of OOO data, which misleads operators.

units.headline: New CompactSelectedSeries persists and evicts chosen head series
units.reason: New public API that writes blocks and evicts head series; data-loss and concurrency risks need a reviewer's judgement.
focus: filterSeriesAndSortPostings and truncateSelectedSeries correctly skip series that got samples after the appendID watermark
FromSelectedSeries blocks are excluded from inOrderBlocksMaxTime and from merges with untagged blocks, so WAL replay cannot drop data
Named-return err plus the defer counts every failure path, including errors from the filter step
Behavior when refs point to series already gone from the head

units.summary: New test checking that a head holding a single timestamp on a chunk-range boundary still produces one block and evicts the series. Test-only code.
units.headline: Test single-timestamp head is persisted and evicted
units.reason: New test with no production effect.

units.summary: New test checking that nil or empty refs is a no-op: no blocks are written and the triggered counter stays at zero. Test-only code.
units.headline: Test empty refs make CompactSelectedSeries a no-op
units.reason: New test with no production effect.
